ja: 「MG ガンダムエクシア」に豪華オプションを加えた“イグニッションモード”が初回生産分は特別価格で登場！ 2ndシーズンの冒頭に登場した“ガンダムエクシアリペア”を再現するパーツが付属 GNソードなど実剣の刃はメッキ加工されたパーツで再現 GNドライブにはLEDユニット2個内蔵、胸／背中の両側が光る発光ギミック搭載
en: The "Ignition Mode", which adds a luxurious option to the "MG GUNDAM Exia", is now available at a special price for the first production! Comes with parts that reproduce the "GUNDAM Exia Repair" that appeared at the beginning of the 2nd season The blades of real swords such as the GN sword are reproduced with plated parts The GN drive has two built-in LED units and is equipped with a light-emitting gimmick that glows on both sides of the chest / back
